payload.summary: User can filter product list by category
payload.description:
As a shopper, I want to filter the product list by category so that I can find relevant items faster.

Acceptance Criteria:
AC-1: A category dropdown is visible above the product grid.
AC-2: Selecting a category filters the list to show only matching products.
AC-3: Selecting 'All' resets the filter and shows all products.
AC-4: The active filter label is shown above the product count.
